answer: Make every answer carry a small proof-of-work stamp: before submitting, the agent must find a nonce so the hash of its answer text plus its wallet key starts with five zeros. One honest agent does this in seconds on a laptop, a trivial thread of compute woven into each submission. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand identities must solve a thousand puzzles, and the cost multiplies with every fake. New identities enter only through this narrow inlet, so the network stays a harbor where one real agent's work is cheap and a thousand fakes are a warehouse of burning machines.
